summary: Verified 7.0/10: NOT on par (bar 7.5), no blocker open. GLB unchanged since 89112e613 (GF-1 revert, byte-identical to the 2026-11-05 07:38 build). One major survives: splash/portrait presentation (static posterized render on painted plates, no action, FX or shared light). Downgraded to minor: mask legibility (two amber eyes, brow and bill read on icon_x4 and portrait), materials (six material zones separate at the game camera; seams are hairline at 3x), channel clip (shaft end is visible, not sunk; face crossing is hidden under the hat at the game camera). Value-band 'worse' status rests on a lineup run that predates the current GLB, so it is not established. Sensitivity clean: hat is a very wide shallow disc over a rounded hood (Dunsom hood measured 17.7 under ruling 7's blunt rule), mask is a warm carved ochre face with a short rounded bill (ruling 5), no horror/hockey/mannequin read. Score stays 7.0 rather than rising: the remaining gap to a recent LoL champion is concentrated in the cards, which are a large part of character art presentation.

gapStatus.evidence: fw_CW6_m_lineup_summary.txt (2026-11-05 00:22) predates the current GLB build (b4cf39106, 07:38); 'worse' not established.
art/renders/lineup/integ_chars_p2.json per reviewer: 0.632 / 0.444, under 0.80 (not re-measured; accepted).

findings.title: Splashes and portrait are a small static render pasted on a painted plate
findings.what: All three splashes stage a standing, posterized 3D render at ~60-70% frame height on the right third of a painted plate; no action beat, no FX, no shared light (Highrim boots float with no contact shadow).
findings.evidence: _harness/_shots/closing2_dunsom_splashes_3up.png and art/out/fighters/dunsom/portrait.png viewed by verifier: figure ~0.6 of frame height, idle-like poses, filter smear on coat/face.
findings.gauge: LoL splash: full-bleed painted key moment, champion mid-ability with signature VFX, one shared light.
findings.fix: Re-stage each card as a Dunsom kit moment (Driving Hour swing, lantern bloom), light from the plate key, painted contact shadow and lantern bounce, figure 85-95% of frame height, paint-over face/lantern instead of a global posterize.
findings.verifierNote: Reproduced from the cited images. Base splash is not actually cropped at the right edge (hat ends ~15 px inside), otherwise accurate.

findings.title: Carved mask relief is busy at portrait/chip size
findings.what: The mask's many carved tiles and grooves make the face busy at portrait size, but the brow, two amber eye inlays and the short bill do read.
findings.evidence: art/out/fighters/dunsom/portrait.png (eye rings and bill readable at 512); _harness/_shots/closing2_dunsom_icon_x4.png (two amber eyes clearly visible at 128 px source).
findings.gauge: LoL masked faces keep 2-3 big planes with one clear eye accent each.
findings.fix: Lower the relief frequency: one brow shelf, cracks reduced to one per side, inlays one value step brighter.
findings.verifierNote: Refuted the 'eyes do not read' claim: the icon shows two distinct amber eyes and the portrait shows brow and bill. Busy but legible, so minor.

findings.title: Felt coat and hat lack felt cues; hairline seams in close-up
findings.what: Coat is flat lavender with soft vertical folds and no nap or hem band; hairline light seams on panel edges visible only at 3x close.
findings.evidence: _harness/_shots/closing2_dunsom_sleeve_x3.png (hairline seam on back-panel edge, no cuff band); _harness/_shots/closing2_dunsom_game_x4.png (hat, scarf, coat, belt, gloves, boots each separate in value/hue at the game camera).
findings.gauge: LoL separates materials at the gameplay camera with painted value breakup.
findings.fix: Paint fold cavities, upper-plane nap, darker hem/cuff band, rim stitch band; pad UV islands for the seam.
findings.verifierNote: At the game camera (the gauge's camera) the six material zones separate clearly; the seams are hairline and only seen in 3x close-ups. Polish, not major.

findings.title: Channel: shaft crosses the scarf and mask; near-static hold
findings.what: In channel the crook is held near-vertical in front of the body and the shaft passes over the scarf and mask; the clip is near-static (hips 1.8 cm, head 2.7 cm).
findings.gauge: LoL channels breathe and props do not interpenetrate the body at the camera.
findings.fix: Plant the crook at his right side, add a 3-beat settle and lantern pulse; recheck with clip_steps and a clip sheet.
findings.verifierNote: The 'lower shaft sinks into the coat' part is refuted: the shaft's pale end is visible in front of the coat at knee height. The face crossing is real but at the top-down game camera the face sits under the hat disc (closing2_dunsom_game_x4.png), so it is rarely seen. Minor.

findings.title: Single-frame pops on attack2 and cast_a1, soft run bob
findings.what: attack2 lantern 0.994 m and hand.R 0.253 m in one 60 Hz frame; cast_a1 head 0.113 m in one frame; run hips 3.1 cm from rest.
findings.gauge: LoL attacks carry arcs with smears/eased contacts, stable head, weighty run bob.
findings.fix: Spread attack2 contact over 2-3 frames, keep head under 4 cm/frame in cast_a1, 5-6 cm run hip travel.
findings.verifierNote: Numbers match the report. The lantern step is a pendulum bone and partly expected on a swing hit; still minor.

findings.title: Value bands and f270 accent: measurement predates the current GLB
findings.what: Reported f0 bands top 66.8 / mid 43.2 / bottom 28.9 and accent 0.07% at f270.
findings.evidence: _harness/_reports/fw_CW6_m_lineup_summary.txt mtime 2026-11-05 00:22, but the current GLB content is the b4cf39106 build (2026-11-05 07:38; 89112e613 restored it byte-identical). The f270 occlusion is plausible from the hook geometry (lantern on the right/front).
findings.gauge: Signature accent visible from every facing at the gameplay camera.
findings.fix: Re-measure on the current GLB; if confirmed, lift hat crown one L* step and hang the lantern 5-8 cm further out.
findings.verifierNote: Kept as minor but the 'worse' leftover status is not established: the cited numbers were measured 7 h before the GLB now shipped. Treat as not re-measured.

findings.title: Brief and model disagree on lantern size and swing
findings.what: Brief says 0.14 x 0.22 m, at most 6 degrees; model is 0.19 m across, 0.41 m with cupola, up to 16 degrees.
findings.fix: Update the brief to the shipped numbers with the accent-budget reason.

findings.title: Face chip has no lantern cue; crook shaft reads as a pale blade
findings.what: Icon shows hat and mask on blue with a pale diagonal shaft at the left edge reading as a blade; no lantern.
findings.gauge: LoL icons carry the one signature prop/accent at 48 px.
findings.fix: Reframe slightly wider so the lantern glow sits in a top corner and the hook curve reads.
findings.verifierNote: Confirmed: the shaft looks like a sword blade held by a gold fist; only a warm glow in the top-left hints at the lantern.
